newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB futures end higher, ignore Sakakibara remarks.
newsitem.headline: JGB futures end higher, ignore Sakakibara remarks.

text.p: *JGB futures ended higher, ignoring senior Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara's comment that JGB market is "bubbly" and there is a risk of the bubble bursting. *Some city banks were detected buying cash JGBs at long-end of yield curve.
"Sakakibara has been making similar remarks recently. The only thing that was different this time was that he used words like 'bubbly'," said a brokerage house trader.
Sakakibara said on Wednesday there was a mood among politicians in favour of raising the official discount rate.

In the morning session, JGB futures showed little reaction to comments by Kabun Muto, director-general of the Management and Coordination Agency, who said the BOJ should raise interest rates by the end of this year.
"Comments by politicians and government officials are starting to lose impact," said the trader.
